structural_claim: Ellipsoidal normal-incidence collector with plasma at first focus and intermediate focus at second focus; laser through central aperture
note: ASML NXE:3400-era slides state ellipsoidal design, plasma at first focus, IF at second focus; central-aperture laser entry stated in S004 §4.

structural_claim: Hydrogen buffer gas flowing away from the collector to stop ions before the mirror
note: Slide 39: H2 ~100 Pa decelerates ions; flow away from collector reduces Sn deposition. Patent pressure values (100-500 mTorr) are not confirmed.

structural_claim: Closed-loop gas recirculation with heat exchangers and filters (US8198615B2 claim 1)

product_evidence.locator: slide 39 ('Vessel with vacuum pumping to remove hot gas and tin vapor')

note: Pumping confirmed; closed-loop recirculation/heat exchanger not confirmed by any product source.

structural_claim: Concentric conical vanes (multi-channel structure) between plasma and IF

product_evidence.locator: §7: 'small obscuration in direct line of sight from the plasma to the intermediate focus'

note: Product evidence supports only an on-axis obscuration, not conical vanes.

structural_claim: Heated vanes on vessel wall deflecting tin to a sump

product_evidence.locator: slide 39 ('Internal hardware to collect micro particles')

note: Internal tin-collecting hardware exists; vane geometry, heating and mesh not confirmed.

structural_claim: CO2 pre-pulse and main pulse at different lines (~10.26 / ~10.59 um) sharing an amplifier chain with polarization isolation

product_evidence.locator: pre-pulse separated from main pulse in optics platform

note: MOPA + CO2 pre-pulse with enhanced isolation confirmed; 10.26 um pre-pulse wavelength and polarization scheme not confirmed in product sources.

structural_claim: All-reflective (Cassegrain-type) final focus with reflectors inside the vessel

product_evidence.locator: §3: NXE:3300 focusing optics 'changed to an all-reflective design'

note: Reflective final focus confirmed from NXE:3300 onward; exact Cassegrain layout of FIG. 5 not confirmed.

structural_claim: Droplet generator using modulated disturbance so droplets coalesce to wider spacing

product_evidence.locator: slides 35-37 ('Large separation between the droplets by special modulation'; small droplets coalesce)

note: Coalescence by modulation described by ASML for the production droplet generator.

structural_claim: Droplet catcher aligned with the droplet path opposite the generator
note: Catcher module exists; backsplash geometry/temperatures of the patent not confirmed.

structural_claim: Collector flow ring with showerhead and perimeter H2 flow and metrology ports
note: Priority 2019 (after NXE:3400B); no source links CFR to NXE:3400.

structural_claim: Laser-curtain / imager droplet trajectory metrology in the vessel

product_evidence.locator: 3D droplet and focus position control at ~50 kHz

note: Vessel-mounted metrology confirmed for NXE:3400C; specific laser-curtain implementation not confirmed.

structural_claim: In-situ hydrogen radical cleaning of tin from collector

product_evidence.locator: §7 ('A tin cleaning technique using hydrogen radicals was developed')

note: Radical cleaning technique confirmed; radical-source placement at collector rim not confirmed.
